policy: Level 1 exact resolution may use only source-record referenceKeys or aliases explicitly listed here. Similar wording is never enough to invent provenance. Context-only keys are excluded from learner-facing exact recommendations. Learning/concept keys describe what to study rather than where the fact came from and must not be counted as missing provenance. Pending source keys remain unresolved until a specific source identity is verified and structured.

conceptKeys.adult-osa-surgery: Treatment concept; exact surgical source should be supplied separately when known.
conceptKeys.aast-abg: Arterial-blood-gas learning concept; the shorthand does not identify a specific verified AAST publication.
conceptKeys.aast-safety-infection: Safety/infection-control learning concept; the combined shorthand does not identify a specific verified AAST publication.
conceptKeys.artifact-troubleshooting: Learning concept spanning technical texts and professional guidance.
conceptKeys.ekg-tech-support: Learning/support concept rather than a bibliographic source identity.
conceptKeys.filter-sensitivity: Instrumentation concept rather than a bibliographic source identity.
conceptKeys.hipaa: Regulatory/privacy learning concept; a single bibliographic source is not implied by this key.
conceptKeys.hypersomnia: Clinical concept spanning ICSD classification and current treatment/testing guidance.
conceptKeys.infection: Safety/infection concept spanning multiple professional sources.
conceptKeys.medication-effects: Learning concept spanning multiple texts and current treatment guidance.
conceptKeys.oxygen-therapy-sleep: Therapy concept spanning oxygen competency, scoring, and treatment sources.
conceptKeys.pap-adherence: Learning concept spanning PAP education, acclimation, and treatment sources.
conceptKeys.pap-titration: Generic PAP skill concept; exact source provenance is separate.
conceptKeys.pap-treatment: Generic PAP treatment concept; exact source provenance is separate.
conceptKeys.pap-troubleshooting: Learning concept spanning technical and textbook sources.
conceptKeys.patient-safety: Safety concept spanning multiple professional and textbook sources.
conceptKeys.pediatric-psg: Pediatric PSG concept spanning scoring, indication, technical, and textbook sources.
conceptKeys.positional-therapy: Treatment concept; exact source provenance is separate.
conceptKeys.report-math: Learning-skill key that should route to Math Coach/report calculation remediation rather than be treated as a citation.
conceptKeys.respiratory-physiology-sleep: Learning concept spanning physiology texts and respiratory literature.
conceptKeys.sleep-disorders-medicine: Broad clinical concept rather than a sufficiently specific source identity.
conceptKeys.uas-therapy: Therapy concept; exact source provenance is separate.
